record.paper_title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
record.original_question: Let Γ be a regular curve and f an analytic and conformal function in the open unit disc. Does f −1 (Γ) necessarily have finite length? (A curve Γ is said to be regular if the intersection of Γ with a disc of radius r has one-dimensional measure at most Cr, where C is a constant independent of r.) (J. L. Fernandez and D. Hamilton)

evidence.quote: Let Γ be a regular curve and f an analytic and conformal function in the open unit disc. Does f −1 (Γ) necessarily have finite length?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Call a curve $\Gamma\subset\mathbb{C}$ regular if there exists a constant $C>0$ such that, for every disc $D$ of radius $r>0$, the one-dimensional Hausdorff measure of $\Gamma\cap D$ is at most $Cr$. Let $f$ be a conformal (i.e. analytic and univalent) map of the open unit disc $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ into $\mathbb{C}$, and let $\Gamma$ be a regular curve in $\mathbb{C}$. Must the preimage $f^{-1}(\Gamma)\subset\mathbb{D}$ have finite one-dimensional Hausdorff measure (i.e. finite length)?
artifact.status_search_result: A 1987 paper by Fernández and Hamilton in Comment. Math. Helv. studies length of curves under conformal mappings, and related results on Ahlfors-regular curves and conformal images exist. However, no source found in the search definitively settles whether the preimage of an arbitrary regular curve under a conformal map of the unit disc must have finite length, so the current status is not clearly established.

status_evidence.title: Length of curves under conformal mappings — Fernández, Hamilton
status_evidence.snippet: Comment. Math. Helv. 62 (1987), 122–134, by J. L. Fernández and D. H. Hamilton, on length behaviour of curves under conformal mappings.
status_evidence.claim: Authors of the question wrote a related paper but the specific question about preimages of regular curves having finite length is not shown to be resolved.

status_evidence.title: Ahlfors-regular curves and Carleson measures
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses how conformal images of Ahlfors-regular curves behave, related but not addressing the preimage finite-length question.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature on conformal mapping and regular curves does not provide a definitive answer to the preimage problem.
